post.meaning: Confucius said: Three kinds of friends are a benefit, and three a harm. Friends who are upright, trustworthy and well informed are a benefit; friends who flatter, who are two-faced and who are glib are a harm.
post.caption:
孔子曰：“益者三友，损者三友。友直、友谅、友多闻，益矣；友便辟、友善柔、有便佞，损矣。”

कन्फ़्यूशियस ने कहा: तीन तरह के मित्र लाभ देते हैं और तीन तरह के हानि। सीधे, भरोसेमंद और बहुत जानने वाले मित्र लाभ देते हैं; चापलूस, दोमुँहे और बातूनी मित्र हानि देते हैं।

Confucius said: Three kinds of friends are a benefit, and three a harm. Friends who are upright, trustworthy and well informed are a benefit; friends who flatter, who are two-faced and who are glib are a harm.

— Confucius, Analects, 16.4

reel.meaning: Whoever is patient and forgives, that is truly a matter of great resolve.
reel.caption:
وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ

और जो सब्र करे और माफ़ कर दे, तो बेशक यह बड़ी हिम्मत के कामों में से है।

Whoever is patient and forgives, that is truly a matter of great resolve.

— Quran, Ash-Shura 42:43
